target_customer: Developers who run several coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex
problem: People running many coding agents must watch each one for questions or handoffs; an inbox that only surfaces what needs attention reduces that load.
business_model: Free and open source (Apache-2.0) app; monetization not stated
product_category: Developer tools, coding agent inbox and orchestration

competitors.name: Conductor
competitors.what: Mac app to run Claude Code, Codex and others in parallel git worktrees

competitors.name: Vibe Kanban
competitors.what: Kanban style manager for coding agents
competitors.traction_then: Company behind it announced shutdown April 10, 2026; repository continued as community project

technical_complexity.rationale: A desktop and web app that coordinates agent messages and handoffs on top of existing coding agents; mostly application engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Open source under Apache-2.0 with many comparable orchestrators, so copying takes weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coding agent vendors ship their own multi-agent management features; the Vibe Kanban shutdown in April 2026 shows the category is hard to monetize.

market_need_then: Several orchestrator tools and roundups in 2026 show many developers running parallel coding agents. Willingness to pay is unclear because leading tools are free or open source.

branding.domain_note: Uses vespin.dev; the company legal entity is Stage Inc., which is the founders' earlier brand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident declaratives such as 'Bring your own keys.'

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo under the ReviewStage GitHub organization; no press found on the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: No coverage found; search surfaces only the parent Stage brand.

outcome_analysis: Vespin is an active Spring 2026 company with no exit and no confirmed funding. It is released free and open source by the team behind Stage, so it may serve as distribution for the code review product; competition and the shutdown of Vibe Kanban suggest weak monetization, but it is too early to classify.
notes: YC page founder bios and launch post describe Stage, a code review platform (stagereview.app), not Vespin; the relation is not explained. A third-party profile lists a $130,000 seed dated 2026-03 with Y Combinator for Stage; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. Competitor dates are year level only for Conductor.
